kinds.name: People
kinds.what: a folder per person — PROFILE.md (who they are, their story, why they matter here) and WORKS.md

kinds.name: Periods
kinds.what: eras and events worth studying on their own

kinds.name: Works
kinds.what: buildings, books, artworks — studied as objects in themselves

kinds.name: Practices
kinds.what: techniques, methods, exercises — things you do (with a level when there is an order)

kinds.name: Resources
kinds.what: what you learn from — books, papers, courses, videos — each with its link and what it contributes

studying.howILearn: Through conversation. You teach; I call out what resonates and we follow that thread; along the way you name the few things worth remembering, and they stick. When we stop, save it: update the pages it touched (what resonated, what to remember), add any idea of mine as a concept, and add a learning-path entry if the inquiry changed direction.

classifications.label: Decision
classifications.note: A decision was made, with the evidence behind it

classifications.label: Assumption
classifications.note: Taken as true, not yet tested

classifications.label: Known issue
classifications.note: A confirmed, stable problem or limitation

classifications.label: Method / how-to
classifications.note: How something should be done or analyzed

classifications.label: Fact from a source
classifications.note: A fact from a source — a spec sheet, a measurement, a document, a test result; without a source it is an assumption

classifications.label: Question / dispute
classifications.note: Someone questions a conclusion, number or record — still open ("are you sure?" counts)

classifications.label: Correction
classifications.note: An earlier statement was wrong; this replaces it. Fill supersedes: and mark the old record superseded

classifications.label: Interpretation
classifications.note: An interpretation or reasoning — not a sourced fact; list what it rests on in references: / source_refs:

classifications.label: Preference
classifications.note: How the owner wants output produced

neverSave: Passwords, API keys and other secrets
Personal medical records — diagnoses, test results, treatment
